stanza: As I sat sadly by her side
The kitten she did gently pass
Over to me and again we pressed
Our indifferent faces to the glass
"That may be very well", I said
"But watch the one falling in the street
See him gesture to his neighbors
And see him trampled beneath their feet
All outward motion connects to nothing
For each is concerned with their immediate need
Witness the man reaching up from the gutter
See the other one stumbling on who can not see"

partner.line: And see him trampled beneath their feet

stanza: Now, I'd walk one mile on just broken glass

Mmm, my Hannah
You're the queen of the street

partner.line: To fall down at your feet

partner.line: Some were bright-eyed, some were dead on their feet
